'''Rilith''' is a weaver's daughter, recently married in [[Jarra (village)|Jarra]].

==Activities==
When Rand came through the village she was caught up in his ''ta'veren'' effect and proposed marriage to [[Jon (blacksmith)|Jon]] the Blacksmith even though he was much older than she. {{ref/book|3|8}}
